landing.heroSub: Estimation with no anchoring, no endless meeting and no guessing. The team plays, the table reveals, the history learns.

round.title: Ninety seconds per story
round.body: Timer on the table, cards face down, simultaneous reveal. The debate happens after the number, not before.

alignment.title: Nobody anchors anybody
alignment.body: Votes stay hidden until reveal, so the senior voice doesn't set the team's number by accident.

memory.title: History that teaches
memory.body: Every round becomes data. The team sees where it underestimated and calibrates the next sprint.

timer.title: Round timer
timer.body: A clock everyone can see, with a soft nudge once you pass the agreed limit.

chips.title: Chips on the table
chips.body: Agreed, explain it, risky — the chip stays bet until the round ends.

call.title: Call the bluff
call.body: Think someone is bluffing? Toss a chip at them and put your disagreement on record.

consensus.title: Consensus & spread
consensus.body: An agreement meter that highlights the outlying votes.

boards.title: Connected boards
boards.body: Jira, IzzyPlan, Trello and GitHub: pull the task in, push the points back.

joinDialog.title: Join a room
joinDialog.description: Paste the room link or enter the ID to continue.
joinDialog.roomIdRequired: Enter a room ID or a valid link.

create.title: Create room
create.subtitle: Set it up in fifteen seconds and share the link.
create.nameRequired: Tell us what to call you

room.tasksSub: Paste the list or import from a connected board.
room.callHintLine: Click someone's name to call their bluff — the chip hits them and drops on the table as a disagree.
room.joinSubtitle: Choose what the table should call you.

result.noNumericVotes: No numeric votes in this round.

room.dispersionStrong: The team is aligned. Close the number and move on.
room.dispersionOk: Two camps here. One minute of debate before you close it.
room.dispersionWeak: High spread: the extreme votes explain first, then run the round again.

tasks.queueEmpty: The queue is empty. Import from a board or paste the list.
tasks.notConnected: Connect {provider} to import issues from the board.
tasks.noIssues: No open issues found on this board.

decks.title: Saved decks
decks.subtitle: Every deck available to any room in the team.
decks.modalSubtitle: Your own cards for this room.
decks.editSubtitle: Adjust the name and the cards of this deck.
decks.name: Deck name
decks.hint: Up to 3 characters per card, comma separated.

estimates.title: Estimates completed
estimates.empty: No estimates closed yet. Reveal a round and accept the number.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Pull tasks from wherever the team already works and push the points back once the estimate closes.
integrations.unavailableHint: OAuth credentials for this provider are not configured on the server.

in.body: Tasks land in the queue with key, title and type — no copy and paste.

out.body: Accept the estimate and the points are written back to the card or issue.

record.body: Every round keeps consensus and duration, and exports as CSV or JSON whenever you want.

jira.name: Jira
jira.description: Issues from your Jira Cloud project, with points written back to the estimate field.

trello.name: Trello
trello.description: Cards from a Trello list, with the points attached to the card.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Open issues from a repository, with the points commented on the issue.

izzyplan.name: IzzyPlan
izzyplan.description: Internal connector. Not publicly available yet.
